item.title: Dr Majed bin Mohammed Al Ansari, Adviser to the Prime Minister and Foreign Ministry spokesperson, told the weekly briefing that Qatari medi…
item.description:
Dr Majed bin Mohammed Al Ansari, Adviser to the Prime Minister and Foreign Ministry spokesperson, told the weekly briefing that Qatari mediation between Washington and Tehran continues and that a meeting with the Iranian side was held on Tuesday evening to discuss proposals on the table, warning that any escalation is "a challenge to the mediation efforts" and that a state of "neither war nor peace" serves no party because it affects Gulf security, energy markets and food security.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/qatars-mediation-continues-meeting-with-iranian-side-expected-advisor-to-prime-minister-foreign-ministry-official-spokesperson · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/264828/latest-news/qatar-continues-mediation-between-us-and-iran-warns-against-escalation · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738497/qatar/qatar-calls-on-all-parties-to-show-restraint-in-crisis

item.title: His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, the Amir, begins a two-day state visit to Switzerland today, Wednesday, at the invitation of …
item.description:
His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, the Amir, begins a two-day state visit to Switzerland today, Wednesday, at the invitation of the Federal Council: an official welcome with military honours on the Bundesplatz in Bern and talks with President Guy Parmelin and the foreign, finance and energy ministers, then a meeting with business leaders on Thursday, before visiting Germany on Friday to meet Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Investment, energy and mediation in regional conflicts top the agenda.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738495/qatar/hh-the-amir-embarks-today-on-visits-to-switzerland-germany · Swiss Federal Council https://www.admin.ch/de/newnsb/UgZNBZzLlYqV

item.title: HE Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani, Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, held two phone calls, with UAE Depu…
item.description:
HE Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani, Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, held two phone calls, with UAE Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan and with Jordan's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, discussing regional developments and de-escalation efforts, and affirmed Qatar's support for every diplomatic effort that protects freedom of maritime navigation and leads to a comprehensive agreement and lasting peace.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/264832/latest-news/prime-minister-uae-deputy-pm-discuss-regional-de-escalation-efforts · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/264833/latest-news/pm-jordanian-deputy-pm-discuss-latest-regional-developments-diplomatic-efforts · The Peninsula (print edition) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/pdf/20261118_1794951145-349.pdf

item.title: The Ministry of Education and Higher Education issued its first regulatory guide for private schools and kindergartens, covering nine areas…
item.description:
The Ministry of Education and Higher Education issued its first regulatory guide for private schools and kindergartens, covering nine areas from administration, human resources, tuition fees and registration to health and safety, student behaviour and assessment. The sector has 354 private schools, 240 of which won the "My White Flag" award for having no violations, and the ministry says success will be measured by fewer repeated breaches rather than the number of penalties.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738501/qatar/moehe-issues-first-private-school-rulebook-to-streamline-system · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/264823/latest-news/qatar-introduces-new-regulatory-guide-to-strengthen-standards-in-private-schools · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/qatar-introduces-new-regulatory-guide-to-strengthen-standards-in-private-schools

item.title: Qatar renewed its strong condemnation of continued Iranian attacks on Bahrain, calling them a flagrant breach of international law that und…
item.description:
Qatar renewed its strong condemnation of continued Iranian attacks on Bahrain, calling them a flagrant breach of international law that undermines diplomatic efforts, a position shared by Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the UAE, while Al Ansari warned that escalation poses an "extremely grave danger" to the chances of reaching an agreement.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/17/11/2026/qatar-strongly-condemns-continued-iranian-attacks-on-bahrain · PBS NewsHour (AP) https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/iran-fires-at-u-s-facility-in-bahrain-as-tehran-resumes-strikes-on-arab-neighbors

item.title: US warplanes on Tuesday evening struck an IRGC missile launch site on Iran's Qeshm Island with precision munitions "in self-defence" in res…
item.description:
US warplanes on Tuesday evening struck an IRGC missile launch site on Iran's Qeshm Island with precision munitions "in self-defence" in response to attacks on US personnel and assets, according to US military officials, while Mehr news agency said the strikes hit several locations without casualties or damage to critical infrastructure.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/11/17/us-jets-strike-irgc-missile-launch-site-on-irans-qeshm-island-in-self-defence/ · Fox News https://www.foxnews.com/world/us-carries-out-self-defense-strike-irgc-missile-launch-site-qeshm-island

item.title: Bahrain said it intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks on Tuesday, the third targeting of US sites on its territory since…
item.description:
Bahrain said it intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks on Tuesday, the third targeting of US sites on its territory since Friday, after the IRGC said it hit a US radar at Sheikh Isa Air Base. US Central Command said no equipment was damaged and no personnel injured, and Secretary of State Marco Rubio called his Bahraini counterpart Abdullatif Al Zayani to reaffirm US security commitments.
Sources: PBS NewsHour (AP) https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/iran-fires-at-u-s-facility-in-bahrain-as-tehran-resumes-strikes-on-arab-neighbors · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/17/iran-and-oman-discuss-maritime-security-amid-rising-attacks-in-strait-of-hormuz/ · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/mena/us-israel-iran-saudi-arabia-yemen-war-live-updates-november-17-2026

item.title: Twenty-four seafarers were evacuated from a tanker that caught fire after a second attack north of Oman's Khasab, including 21 Indians resc…
item.description:
Twenty-four seafarers were evacuated from a tanker that caught fire after a second attack north of Oman's Khasab, including 21 Indians rescued, two injured and one still missing, while Iran's navy said a supertanker carrying more than two million barrels and a gas carrier struck mines in the strait.
Sources: Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/mena/us-israel-iran-saudi-arabia-yemen-war-live-updates-november-17-2026 · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/17/live-iran-war-oman-tanker-indian-crew-india/ · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/17/iran-and-oman-discuss-maritime-security-amid-rising-attacks-in-strait-of-hormuz/

item.title: Omani Foreign Minister Badr Al Busaidi discussed maritime corridor security, de-escalation and reviving dialogue with Iranian counterpart A…
item.description:
Omani Foreign Minister Badr Al Busaidi discussed maritime corridor security, de-escalation and reviving dialogue with Iranian counterpart Abbas Araghchi in Muscat, while Iranian parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf raised the stakes, saying any dam, port or power plant near a US or Israeli base is now "dual-use".
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/17/iran-and-oman-discuss-maritime-security-amid-rising-attacks-in-strait-of-hormuz/ · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/mena/us-israel-iran-saudi-arabia-yemen-war-live-updates-november-17-2026

item.title: The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen said it intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone in the Riyadh region on Tuesday, after two dr…
item.description:
The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen said it intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone in the Riyadh region on Tuesday, after two drones were downed over Makkah and Riyadh on Monday, while the Houthis said they targeted the East-West pipeline. Etihad Airways cancelled flights between Abu Dhabi, Dammam and Riyadh until 30 November.
Sources: Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/houthi-drone-intercepted-in-riyadh-region-coalition-says-3012514 · House of Saud https://houseofsaud.com/coalition-intercepts-riyadh-makkah-drones-nov17/ · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/mena/us-israel-iran-saudi-arabia-yemen-war-live-updates-november-17-2026

item.title: Dubai International handled 50.4 million passengers in the first nine months of 2026, down 28.1% because of the war, and 18.8 million in th…
item.description:
Dubai International handled 50.4 million passengers in the first nine months of 2026, down 28.1% because of the war, and 18.8 million in the third quarter (−22.1%); CEO Paul Griffiths expects 70 million this year against a record 95.2 million in 2025, with British Airways back and Lufthansa resuming flights on 25 November.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/aviation/2026/11/17/dubai-airport-handles-more-than-50-million-passengers-as-airlines-resume-flights/ · Business Recorder (Reuters) https://www.brecorder.com/news/40449330/dubais-dxb-passenger-traffic-down-28-in-first-nine-months-as-conflict-disrupts-regional-travel

item.description:
Prime Minister Dr Mostafa Madbouly reviewed plans to deliver one million housing units over the next four years to 2030 through six programmes, with rental, rent-to-own and social housing making up about 65% of the target, and proposed land plots and the geographic distribution of the first phase were presented.

item.title: Egypt and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, in the presence of the Prime Minister, signed a memorandum to launch a plat…
item.description:
Egypt and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, in the presence of the Prime Minister, signed a memorandum to launch a platform to promote and govern investment in industry's green transition, aiming to cut emissions, expand renewables, improve energy efficiency and keep exports competitive under new environmental requirements, on the sidelines of the World Economic Forum meeting in Cairo.
Sources: Elzman News https://www.elzmannews.com/547703 · Amwal Al Ghad https://en.amwalalghad.com/egypt-ebrd-sign-mou-to-boost-green-investments-in-industrial-sector/ · Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/egypts-private-sector-investment-up-26-el-sisi-tells-world-economic-forum-3012533

item.title: Wall Street closed Tuesday with broad losses for a fourth day: the Dow fell 848.75 points (1.64%) to 50,759.42, the S&P 500 1.03% to 7,340.…
item.description:
Wall Street closed Tuesday with broad losses for a fourth day: the Dow fell 848.75 points (1.64%) to 50,759.42, the S&P 500 1.03% to 7,340.53 and the Nasdaq 0.74% to 24,328.38, while the VIX jumped 11.13% to 25.46, amid worries over AI spending and a 95.4% chance of a 25-basis-point rate hike in December.
Sources: MarketScreener (Reuters) https://www.marketscreener.com/news/wall-street-ends-lower-ahead-of-nvidia-results-focus-turns-to-anthropic-debut-ce785edcdc81fe2d · Yahoo Finance (Motley Fool) https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-today-nov-17-222310679.html

item.title: Nvidia beat forecasts with quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion (+103% year on year) against estimates of $109.15 billion and data centre re…
item.description:
Nvidia beat forecasts with quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion (+103% year on year) against estimates of $109.15 billion and data centre revenue of $107.6 billion, and guided to $130 billion for the fourth quarter, lifting the stock about 5% after hours. The board chairman said the company does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and has hired a firm to find a successor.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/markets/2026/11/17/nvidia-earnings-q3-jensen-huang/ · Yahoo Finance (Motley Fool) https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-today-nov-17-222310679.html · TradingKey https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/more/262309976-japan-korea-stocks-skhy-kospi-nikkei-samsung-skhynix-softbank-kioxia-nvda-tradingkey

item.title: Tensions are rising at COP31 in Antalya over an 18-page draft that includes both "transitioning away" from and "phasing out" fossil fuels a…
item.description:
Tensions are rising at COP31 in Antalya over an 18-page draft that includes both "transitioning away" from and "phasing out" fossil fuels and a call for wealthy nations to reach net zero by 2030. EU envoy Wopke Hoekstra said the draft could make negotiations "untenable", with the official close set for Friday, 20 November.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/17/tensions-rise-over-draft-climate-deal-at-cop31 · WHBL (Reuters) https://whbl.com/2026/11/16/first-draft-of-cop31-deal-signals-tough-negotiations-to-come/
